# Plan: Dash Approach Cell Test

## Overview
A stage plan with an Approach column present but the cell contains only a dash ("-").
Used to verify that a dash Approach cell is refused (catalogue S2) when requireApproach=true.

## Stages

| Stage | Name | Goal | Depends On | HITL | Approach |
|-------|------|------|------------|:----:|----------|
| 1 | Foundation | First stage | - | FALSE | - |
